title: E8_MUSIC Canonical Sonification: Deterministic Source-Forced WAV Profiles with Lean 4 Formal Assurance
description: E8_MUSIC v1.1.0 provides deterministic canonical/source-forced WAV profiles with a pinned Lean 4 reference formalization, theorem-to-code claim inventory, and executable JavaScript binary64/byte/hash conformance vectors.
